resources.name: Open-source plane-wave DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO)

access.notes: Any DFT code supporting GGA-PW91 exchange-correlation and ultrasoft pseudopotentials; Quantum ESPRESSO with SSSP or PSLibrary pseudopotentials is a suitable choice.

resources.notes: The paper used the proprietary code CASTEP; an open-source equivalent is required to execute the DFT calculations.
